listings.title: 2675 N Sparrow Loop
listings.description: Remodeled two-story home offering 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and 2,729 sq ft of spacious, flexible living. The open-concept main floor features a beautifully updated kitchen with butcher block island, stainless steel appliances, open shelving and a convenient butler's pantry, plus a comfortable living room with an electric fireplace and half bath. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers an updated bathroom and walk-in closet, along with 2 additional bedrooms and a large bonus room that could easily serve as a 6th bedroom, office or playroom. The finished basement includes a generous family room, 2 spacious bedrooms, full bathroom and laundry room. Additional features include a 2-car garage, gas heat and central A/C. Outside, enjoy a covered back patio, fully fenced backyard, fire pit, storage shed, fenced dog run and front & back sprinkler system. Conveniently located near parks, schools and walking trails!

listings.title: 1791 Pup Paw Trl
listings.description: Spanning 94.5 acres of prime North Idaho ground, this property showcases a beautiful mix of open meadows, timbered hillsides, a year-round artesian spring, year-round creek and a spring-fed pond that remains full throughout the seasons. The 4 bed, 2 bath, 2,050 sq ft home offers comfortable off-grid living with acacia hardwood floors, updated cabinets, countertops, appliances, and a Quadra-Fire wood stove. Solar power with updated panels and batteries, plus a hydroelectric system, provide year-round functionality. Outbuildings are extensive, including a 30x48 shop with 10’ and 12’ lean-tos (totaling approx 48x52), wired with breaker box and outlets with lighting prepped. Additional improvements include a 24x30 barn, 10x20 shed with lofts, 10x12 greenhouse, multiple utility sheds, round pen, and two fenced pastures. Well-equipped acreage offering space, functionality, and flexibility for a variety of rural lifestyles.

listings.title: 1791 Pup Paw Trl
listings.description: Rare 144.5-acre off-grid North Idaho property where the land is the true centerpiece with expansive meadows, timbered hillsides, a year-round artesian spring, year-round creek and a year-round spring-fed pond. Rich with history, the property features patented mining ground with tailings, a mine shaft, and original survey and deed signed by Woodrow Wilson. The main house features 4 beds, 2 baths, and 2,050 sq ft of comfortable off-grid living with acacia hardwood floors, updated cabinets, countertops, appliances, and a Quadra-Fire wood stove. Solar power with updated panels & batteries, plus a hydroelectric system, provide year-round functionality. A secondary ~900 sq ft cabin with loft adds flexibility for guests or renters. Outbuildings include a large 48x52 shop with lean-tos, 10x20 shed with lofts, greenhouse & additional shed. The 24x30 barn, round pen setup and two pastures provide a functional layout for livestock. A rare blend of usable land, natural beauty, and self-sufficient infrastructure.

listings.title: 614 Telemark Rd
listings.description: Ready to go Ski in / Ski out lot on Schweitzer Mountain with access to Creekside Chairlift. The unseen hard work has been done including land and geo tech surveys, tree clearing, storm water draining plan, Schweitzer committee meeting approval as well as Bonner County building permit approval. Engineering and house plans are also included.  This lot is gently sloping and .54 of an acre in size. Community water and sewer available while avoiding HOA fees. Use the current plan and save time and money or create your own new vision. Schweitzer master plan calls for a ski in / ski out road at the bottom of property for easier access to the slopes, a new lodge below the property and another chairlift planned to the back side of the mountain. This is your chance to get a lot in an ideal location before the inevitable price increases.

listings.title: 16111 N Yale Rd
listings.description: Single-level home on .9 acre with a massive shop & income-producing ADU! Offering 3,824 sq ft, this home features 5 bedrooms (2 non-conforming in the basement) and 3 bathrooms. The main level welcomes you with LVP flooring & cozy wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen is equipped with quartz countertops, a gas range and flows seamlessly into the dining room, then the family room with floor-to-ceiling windows. The spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet & private deck with a hot tub. Finished basement includes a large family room, 2 non-conforming bedrooms, bathroom, office & storage room. Outside, enjoy the level 0.9-acre lot with beautiful landscaping, fenced backyard, covered patio, deck, storage shed and an impressive 40x60 insulated shop with power. Adding even more value is the detached 1,600 sq ft ADU featuring 1 bed & 1 bath, currently generating $1,600 per month. This unique property offers the perfect combo of space, functionality & investment potential.

listings.title: 22292 N Leclerc Rd
listings.description: A Rare 90.88-Acre Hunters & Recreationist Paradise with 100' Deeded Pend Oreille River Frontage, offering full recreational freedom, abundant wildlife, ponds, natural spring, and miles of riding trails plus deeded waterfront—is an exceptionally rare offering. This private sanctuary borders Simpson land, enhancing both privacy and access to untouched wilderness. Priest Lake is just a scenic 21-miles ATV trip. A newly reimagined custom home provides year-round living off a county maintained road with a whole-house generator and all the comforts in a private setting. The impressive 30×60 shop with ADU living, and 30×40 four-bay lean-to create unmatched space for equipment, guests, and multi-use living. A private riverfront beach is already set up for additional RV parking, making tA rare opportunity to own a turnkey sanctuahis an ideal retreat for gatherings and extended stays.A truly rare combination of land, lifestyle, and riverfront access. Whole house generator. 2 RV hook-ups with power.

listings.title: 22292 N Leclerc Rd
listings.description: Turn-key secondary waterfront estate on the Pend Oreille River, 10.73 acres of perfectly landscaped, recreation-ready grounds. No CCRs or HOA. Freshly updated geodesic 3-bed, 2.5-bath home offering tons of natural light, creating a bright interior that showcases its stunning architecture. Breathtaking riverfront sunset view. Direct access to the private community waterfront/river launch, giving you effortless entry to the river for boating, kayaking, fishing, and year-round adventure. The home is equipped with a whole-house generator, ensuring reliable power. Massive 30×60 shop w/ 220 power, brand-new 1-bedroom, 1-bath living space with full laundry—ideal for guests, recreation partners, or potential vacation rental income. Full RV hookups and a 30×40 lean-to for storing boats, ATVs, and trailers. Fully furnished, truly turn-key, on a paved county-maintained road for reliable year-round access. Rare opportunity to own a versatile river retreat,modern amenities,perfect as a private home,vacation rental.

listings.title: 6472 Enterprise Rd
listings.description: Once in a lifetime opportunity awaits with this gorgeous. private cabin on Lake Roosevelt. Have your family and friends park their boat at the beach with only a 2-minute walk up to the guest cabin, attached garage and basketball court. Relax in the hot tub and enjoy these amazing views. Plenty of storage and extra parking with the additional 30x40shop, fenced garden area, raised beds, chicken coop, rock waterfall, pump house, outdoor shower with additional bathroom, sprinkler system, fire pit, gazebo, deer hunting stands, year-round pond, apple trees, blackberries, raspberries, morel mushrooms, and a well-maintained trail to the beach.

listings.title: 2327 S Fairmont Estates Dr
listings.description: Experience elevated living in desirable Fairmont Estates, where refined design, expansive spaces and breathtaking views come together. This stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence offers 4,400+ sq ft of beautifully designed living space, including a fully finished daylight basement with full bath—ideal for guests, recreation, media or a private retreat. The main level features an inviting great room with gas fireplace, custom bench seating, a gourmet kitchen with abundant cabinetry, island and gas range, and an open-concept layout made for effortless entertaining. Step outside to the covered deck and take in spectacular views! Upstairs, the spacious primary suite, additional bedrooms and versatile loft provide comfort and flexibility. The landscaped backyard is a private sanctuary, complete with a peaceful patio, a tranquil water feature and designated BBQ area for grilling & gathering. A 3-car garage and outside shed add convenience & storage. Minutes from parks, trails, shopping, dining and I-90. Perfection!

listings.title: 22829 E Red Feather Ln
listings.description: This beautiful 9 acre is prepped and ready! lot has a full time creek running through it and is ready for multiple "to be built" architectural designs! Septic is engineered for a 6 bedroom home, 40 gpm well is drilled and ready and the largest transformer Avista offers is onsite and installed. Many designs to choose from to customize your Liberty Lake Dream! Paved and gated right to the build site!

listings.title: 10208 N West Newman Lake Dr
listings.description: A rare opportunity to own a "barndominium" or "shome" (shop home) on nearly 49 acres! The 1 bedroom, 1 bath home was designed with exceptional taste and style.  The kitchen has all stainless steel appliances, beautiful granite counter tops and hickory cabinets. New mini-split A/C's installed. The 4+ car shop below has been roughed in for living space, including a front door style entrance. A large deck is a perfect place to view the expansive landscape and mountains, take in the abundant wildlife, or just relax to a gorgeous sunset. Septic is approved for 5 bedrooms so the new owner can construct a new residence and convert this back to an accessory unit. Possibilities are endless! Agriculture parcel was used to grow hay. Lean-to off structure and another covered area for equipment/hay/animal area. Fenced, cross-fenced & electric fencing.

listings.title: 505 E Hawthorne Rd
listings.description: Welcome to Sienna Terrace, a new 18-unit apartment complex currently at 100% occupancy! Located in north Spokane and just a few short blocks from Whitworth University, this thoughtfully designed community offers a collection of 1BR, 2BR, and 3BR units. Each luxury apartment features an open-concept floor plan, contemporary finishes, and large windows that fill the interiors with natural light. There are 6- one bed/one bath units; 9- two bed/two bath units; and 3- three bed/two bath units. This prime location is just 7 miles from downtown Spokane and less than 1/2 mile from the Whitworth University campus, which has a current enrollment of over 2500 students. Tenants will love the numerous shopping and dining options nearby, with Target, Best Buy, Dick's Sports, Olive Garden, Red Robin and the YMCA among the many businesses and restaurants within 1/2 mile.
